note.en: 1986-2019: computed price = LBMA international annual-average gold price (USD/troy oz) x Bank of Korea annual-average KRW/USD rate / 31.1035; this is a derived figure, not an actual domestic transaction price (excludes 10% VAT and fabrication fees charged at jewellers). 2020-2025: actual annual-average KRX Gold Market (Korea Exchange) closing price, traded in 1g units, excluding VAT charged when withdrawing physical gold. Price per 1 don (3.75g) = this value x 3.75.
